svg.aria-label: How an agent is verified: survey, groundtruth.json, Imposter, adapter, promotion
svg.title: How an agent is verified: survey, groundtruth.json, Imposter, adapter, promotion
svg.desc: A loop with five stations. 01, survey: the exact release runs and its traffic is captured. 02, groundtruth.json: one file per agent says what its surface is. 03, Imposter: a stand-in built from that file plays the agent. 04, adapter: mapped to that file and locked by its digest. 05, promotion: real-agent tests on every platform move the badge. The first two are what the agent really does; the next two are tested with no vendor software. The loop closes when the agent ships a new version.
